title: events.subscribe
description: Subscribes the connection to events for every pane in the session, as pane.list sees them, and to pane.output for the caller's own pane and the panes it spawned only; other panes' output is never sent. Needs hello version 2 and a caller with a controlling terminal. One subscription per connection; a second is refused. After the result the core sends notifications, {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "event", "params": <event>}, with no id. A subscriber that lets 2 MiB of them queue unread is closed.

event.description: The params of a notification: pane numbers, status and exit status, never screen contents or titles, except the text of pane.output.

status.description: Not with pane.closed or pane.output. As pane.list reports it, from OSC 133 marks that output can fake.

exit.description: Not with pane.closed or pane.output. The last exit status the shell gave, or null.

text.description: With pane.output only: what the pane printed, as plain text without escape sequences, at most 4096 bytes an event. The caller's own pane's text comes as it is printed. Another pane's comes redacted and in whole lines, an unfinished line going out once it passes 4 KiB, and a PEM block whole once its END line comes; a block over 64 KiB is dropped and sent as one [redacted] line.
